$description: Interaction states (library plan wave 1, foundation interaction-states): the state roles that are not colors. The state colors are the theme's roles (--plx-sys-state-hover, -state-pressed, -state-selected, -accent-state-hover, -focus-ring-color, -content-disabled), set per light and dark mode; system/interaction.css draws every treatment from both.

state-disabled-opacity.$description: Disabled treatment on the accent and inverse surfaces: the whole element dims to this opacity (on a surface the text takes --plx-sys-content-disabled instead).

state-dragged-opacity.$description: Dragged treatment: the lifted item, raised with the overlay shadow, at this opacity so the drop target shows through it.

state-drag-origin-opacity.$description: Dragged treatment: the place the item was picked up from (its placeholder) dims to this opacity while it moves.

state-inverse-rest-opacity.$description: On the inverse surface (a toast, a tooltip): an action's content at rest. There is no lighter fill step on the inverse surface, so hover, pressed and selected bring the content to full strength.

state-inverse-active-opacity.$description: On the inverse surface: an action's content while hovered, pressed or selected (full strength).
